quality.finding: The existing no-terminal-newline test establishes load-only validity; storage.append_observations reads the valid final row then appends without a separator. runner.run_once appends before archive reload and handoff publication. An exception after append may leave the archive mutated/malformed even while all three handoffs remain unchanged; such a result is NOT fail-closed. This is a source-derived risk, not an executed regression or production incident.
quality.required_oracle: On exact SHA, in isolated no-network tmp_path, seed valid rowA JSONL without final newline and snapshot archive plus all three baseline handoffs. Prevalidate distinct PIT-visible rowB. Run run_once with rowB. PASS only if either (1) archive contains exactly two individually parseable lines and returned/persisted handoffs agree on rowB, with replay dedup, or (2) explicit rejection occurs before any archive/handoff mutation and rowA remains readable. A ValueError after corrupting archive is RED, not acceptable rejection. Preserve original failure, do not weaken assertions.
quality.proof_boundary: No independent executable checkout; no exact-SHA targeted/full pytest executed.

blocker.verbatim_error: CalledProcessError: Command '['git', 'diff', '--check']' returned non-zero exit status 2.
blocker.missing: Authorized disposable exact-SHA checkout or sanitized pre-reset patch, diff-check stderr and pytest transcripts.
blocker.recovery: Obtain execution or retained diagnostics; run no-newline commit-or-no-mutation, role identity, overlap, rollback, orphan targeted regressions then full python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests with retained logs. No blind Gemini enqueue.
